topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Well, now, isn’t this something! I was out fetching water when I stumbled upon a piece of parchment tucked away in a nook of the well. It was Eliza’s, or so it seems. Written down were all manner of things she wished to see and do—silly and serious, light and bold. A pilgrimage to the shrine of Saint Catherine, a taste of honey from the high meadows, watching the sunrise from the old mill. I couldn’t help but chuckle and shake my head. It’s funny, how we all have dreams that reach beyond the furrows, beyond the daily churn. I reckon I’ll share a few of mine with her come evening. Maybe we can tick a few off, together.
